translations.literal: Guoliang was a man of Haicheng in Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Guoliang came from Haicheng in Fujian.

sentences.zh: 世襲騎都尉，授廣東碣石鎮標游擊，累遷海澄副將，繼標為左翼鎮總兵。

translations.literal: He inherited the rank of Cavalry Commandant, was appointed naval lieutenant-colonel of the Jieshi standard in Guangdong, was promoted in succession to deputy commander of Haicheng, and succeeded Biao as regional commander of the Left Wing Town.
translations.idiomatic: He inherited the rank of Cavalry Commandant, served as naval lieutenant-colonel of the Jieshi garrison in Guangdong, rose to deputy commander of Haicheng, and succeeded Biao as regional commander of the Left Wing garrison.

sentences.zh: 十三年，追剿烏石二於丫洲洋，擊沉數艘，賊艦續至益多。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he pursued and suppressed Wushi Er at Yazhou Sea, sank several vessels, but bandit ships continued arriving in ever greater numbers.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he pursued Wushi Er to Yazhou Bay, sank several junks, but pirate ships kept arriving in ever greater numbers.

sentences.zh: 國良以傷殞，優恤，諡果壯。

translations.literal: Guoliang died of his wounds; generous posthumous care was granted, and he was given the posthumous name Guozhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Lin Guoliang died of his wounds. The court granted generous posthumous honors and gave him the posthumous name Guozhuang.

sentences.zh: 廷桂，廣東歸善人。

translations.literal: Tinggui was a man of Guishan in Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Tinggui came from Guishan in Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 由行伍擢千總。

translations.literal: From the ranks he was promoted to company commander.
translations.idiomatic: He rose from the ranks to company commander.

sentences.zh: 乾隆中，從征台灣，累遷海門營參將。

translations.literal: During Qianlong he followed campaigns in Taiwan and was promoted in succession to garrison colonel of the Haimen Garrison.
translations.idiomatic: During the Qianlong reign he fought in Taiwan and rose in due course to garrison colonel of the Haimen Garrison.

sentences.zh: 國良歿，護理左翼鎮總兵。

translations.literal: When Guoliang died he acted as regional commander of the Left Wing Town.
translations.idiomatic: When Lin Guoliang died, he served as acting regional commander of the Left Wing garrison.

sentences.zh: 十四年，擊殲匪首總兵保於外洋，圍其餘黨。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he attacked and destroyed the bandit chieftain Zongbing Bao on the outer sea and besieged the rest of his faction.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he destroyed the bandit leader Zongbing Bao on the open sea and besieged the remainder of his force.

sentences.zh: 張保仔率大隊來援。

translations.literal: Zhang Baozi led a large force to relieve them.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Baozi arrived with a large relief force.

sentences.zh: 眾寡不敵，廷桂死之。

translations.literal: Outnumbered, Tinggui was killed.
translations.idiomatic: Outnumbered, Xu Tinggui was killed.

sentences.zh: 賜卹，予雲騎尉世職。

translations.literal: Posthumous care was granted and he was given the hereditary office of Cloud Cavalry Captain.
translations.idiomatic: The court granted posthumous honors and awarded his family the hereditary rank of Cloud Cavalry Captain.

sentences.zh: 洎蔡牽既滅，惟粵匪存，於是百齡為兩廣總督，乃斷接濟，整軍紀，越一年，剿撫以次定。

translations.literal: By the time Cai Qian had been destroyed, only Guangdong bandits remained; Bailin then became governor-general of the two Guang provinces, cut off supplies, tightened military discipline, and within a year suppression and pacification settled matters in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Once Cai Qian was destroyed, only Guangdong bandits remained. Governor-General Bailin cut off their supplies, tightened military discipline, and within a year settled the coast through a combination of force and negotiation.

sentences.zh: 東南海氛始靖。

translations.literal: The troubled atmosphere on the southeast sea was at last pacified.
translations.idiomatic: At last the southeast coast was at peace.

sentences.zh: 論曰：東南海寇之擾，始末十有餘年。

translations.literal: The commentators say: The disturbance of southeast sea bandits lasted from beginning to end more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: The commentators observe: The southeast sea pirates plagued the coast for more than ten years.

sentences.zh: 惟浙師李長庚一人能辦賊，以閩帥牽掣而阻成功，然長庚忠誠勇略聞於海內，上結主知，廟算既孚，乃專倚畀。

translations.literal: Only Li Changgeng of the Zhejiang fleet alone could deal with the bandits; Fujian commanders hampered and obstructed his success, yet Changgeng's loyalty, courage, and strategy were known throughout the realm; he won the emperor's trust, the court's plans were in accord, and he alone was relied upon.
translations.idiomatic: Only Li Changgeng of the Zhejiang fleet could truly fight the pirates, though Fujian commanders hampered his success. His loyalty, courage, and strategic skill were known throughout the empire; he won the emperor's trust, and once court strategy aligned with his efforts, the throne relied on him alone.

sentences.zh: 洎閩、浙合力，賊勢浸衰，不幸長庚中殞，而王得祿、邱良功等以部將承其遺志，卒殲渠魁。

translations.literal: When Fujian and Zhejiang combined their strength, the bandits' power gradually declined; unfortunately Changgeng was struck down in mid-career, but Wang Delu, Qiu Lianggong, and others as subordinate commanders inherited his purpose and in the end destroyed the ringleader.
translations.idiomatic: When Fujian and Zhejiang joined forces, pirate power gradually waned. Changgeng fell in battle, but Wang Delu, Qiu Lianggong, and other subordinates carried on his mission and eventually destroyed the rebel leader.

sentences.zh: 粵將惟黃標可用，而未盡其才。

translations.literal: Among Guangdong commanders only Huang Biao was usable, yet his talent was not fully employed.
translations.idiomatic: Among Guangdong commanders only Huang Biao was truly capable, yet his abilities were never fully used.

sentences.zh: 百齡乘閩、浙殄賊之後，剿撫兼施，遂如摧枯拉朽。

translations.literal: Bailin, riding the aftermath of Fujian and Zhejiang's extermination of the bandits, applied both suppression and pacification, and thus it was like breaking dry wood and pulling rotten stakes.
translations.idiomatic: After Fujian and Zhejiang had destroyed the main pirate forces, Bailin combined military suppression with negotiated surrender, and the remaining resistance collapsed like dry timber.

sentences.zh: 要之海戰惟恃船堅砲利，與斷接濟而已，循之則勝，違之則敗。

translations.literal: In sum, naval warfare depends only on sturdy ships and powerful cannon, and on cutting off supplies; follow this and you win, violate it and you lose.
translations.idiomatic: In short, naval warfare depends on strong ships, heavy guns, and cutting off supplies. Follow that path and you win; ignore it and you lose.

sentences.zh: 得失之林，故無幸哉！

translations.literal: Gain and loss form a forest of examples—therefore there is no luck in it!
translations.idiomatic: Success and failure follow such a clear pattern that chance has little to do with it!
